text: Chapter 7. The observatory sat above the cloud line, and at night the dome opened with a sound like a ship leaving harbor. Tomas climbed the spiral stairs with the day's coordinates folded in his pocket, knowing that somewhere in the strip of sky assigned to him a point of light was waiting that no catalogue had named. He had stopped telling people what he was looking for; the looking itself had become the answer he gave.

Saturation vapor pressure is the pressure exerted by a vapor in thermodynamic equilibrium with its condensed phase at a given temperature. It rises steeply with temperature, approximately following the Clausius-Clapeyron relation, which is why warm air can hold substantially more moisture than cold air and why dew forms when surfaces radiatively cool below the dew point overnight.

Section 4.2 Replacing the coolant loop filter. Power down the rack and wait for the pump pressure indicator to read zero before opening the service panel. Close both isolation valves, release the quick-disconnect collar, and withdraw the filter cartridge straight back to avoid stressing the manifold. Install the new cartridge until the collar clicks, reopen the valves slowly, and verify there are no weep points at the seals before restoring power.
